observational_status: Eight normalized-native M3D-C1 open-loop source cases; no imported experimental shot, calibrated source-current integral, equilibrium/profile handoff, or segmented controller-in-loop
successful_milestone: Eight fixed-dt=0.000625 normalized-native M3D-C1 cases completed in 628.47 seconds on matched 1004-element meshes. Exact zero-source field equivalence passed (max delta 0). Finite signed-amplitude jphi responses were resolved at t=0.01/0.02/0.03. Quantitative amplitude linearity was not established.
interpretation: At t=0.03 doubling command magnitude from 0.005 to 0.01 gives fieldwise relative deviations from twice the nominal response of 45.39% negative and 79.84% positive. These are informative deviations from proportional scaling, not solver/pipeline failures; they weaken a simple linear actuator-response surrogate. The native e[2]-weighted proxy remains uncalibrated, and the fixed-dt result cannot establish temporal convergence or a physical current integral.
followup_scope: One bounded matched-time native W_sheet/Jpk/high-J/reconnection/energy observable audit at the same fine dt with source-off and same-mode-zero controls, preserving frozen width/Jpk thresholds without treating open-loop comparisons as controller authority.
handoff_equivalence: unvalidated; zero-source equivalence is not experimental shot handoff
pb11_fidelity_limits: not_applicable; no p-B11 reaction, proton recirculation, radiation/electron loss, alpha transport/channeling, boron delivery, direct conversion, rotating plasma, rotation/shear, liquid lithium, ignition margin or net-power evidence
m3dc1_claim_boundary: Normalized-native M3D-C1 fixed-dt jphi amplitude-response diagnostics only; uncalibrated e[2], no temporal convergence, physical injected current, segmented-electrode authority, calibrated shot handoff, causal TCT stabilization or reactor net power.
